subject: Request: SLA grace period + retro billing offset for Streamline AI
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena@streamline.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Torres <ben.torres@streamline.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production latency spikes (Sept 25-27) — request for credit and SLA exception

Markus / Monica,

We saw sustained 95th/99th percentile latency spikes across our inference calls during the weekend of Sept 25-27 that materially affected customer-facing features (search suggestions and chat). Our engineering team captured time-series and traces (attached). The issue caused several user-facing errors and an estimated revenue impact for us this month.

What we need from Redwood immediately:
- A retroactive billing offset or credit to cover the estimated impact window (Sept 25-27).
- A temporary SLA grace period (waive penalties while you investigate, so we can avoid contract triggers while we coordinate).
- A clear ETA for the RCA and mitigation plan.

We value the platform and want to resolve this quickly. Please let me know internal next steps and the credit/offset you can provide. Finance and procurement are copied — we will need a formal credit memo or contract amendment for accounting.

Attachments: incident-timeline-sept25-27.pdf (6 pages; executive timeline + traces)

Thanks,
Lena Park
Head of Product Operations
Streamline AI

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Production latency spikes (Sept 25-27) — request for credit and SLA exception

Team — forwarding Streamline's ask. Quick summary: multi-region latency spike over weekend; customer reports revenue impact and wants both a retro credit and a short-term contractual grace so they don't hit escalation triggers.

Suggested approach (proposal for exec approval):
- Offer two weeks of waived usage charges (applied as credit on next invoice).
- Apply an additional 10% credit on their current monthly invoice to offset estimated loss.
- Provide RCA link and commit to follow-up checkpoint within 5 business days.

Note: the $ value here may exceed my delegation for one-off credits (ballpark ~$42k if applied as proposed). I am attaching a quick calc. Requesting Karthik's sign-off for anything above $25k.

Attachments: billing-offset-calc.xlsx

Can you weigh in with recommended customer language? I want to be responsive but keep approvals intact.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Account Management
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production latency spikes (Sept 25-27) — request for credit and SLA exception

Markus — +1 on the two-week waiver + 10% credit. Suggested external phrasing below (short and action-oriented):

"We sincerely regret the disruption on Sept 25-27. We've completed an initial mitigation to stabilize performance and are working on a full RCA. As a gesture, Redwood will apply two weeks of waived usage charges and a 10% credit to your Sept invoice. We'll provide the RCA and a remediation plan by Oct 5 and schedule a 30-minute review with your team."

That should keep things moving and satisfy procurement.

—Aditya
Enterprise AE

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request — Streamline credit/grace period

Markus — thanks for the summary. Approve the following one-time package with conditions: 

1) Two calendar weeks of waived usage charges (applied as a credit on their next invoice).
2) 10% credit on their September invoice.
3) Combined financial relief capped at $40,000. If the proposed relief exceeds that cap, bring it back to me with a short justification.
4) Legal to prepare a short amendment/credit memo; finance to process the credit. Procurement must confirm acceptance in writing.
5) Require the RCA link and a remediation checkpoint by Oct 5.

Also add an invitation for a free 1-month monitoring review with our solutions team (no charge) to restore confidence. Please proceed and loop legal/finance.

—Karthik
VP, Sales Operations

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@streamline.ai>, Ben Torres <ben.torres@streamline.ai>, procurement@streamline.ai
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: remedial package & credit for Sept 25-27 latency event

Lena / Ben / procurement team —

Thank you for sending the incident timeline. First, I want to reiterate our apologies for the disruption. We take platform reliability very seriously. Per internal approvals, here's the remedial package Redwood can offer immediately: 

- Two calendar weeks of waived usage charges (applied as a credit on your next invoice).
- A 10% credit on your September invoice.
- Combined relief capped at $40,000 (this is a one-time exception approved by our leadership).
- We will provide a full RCA and an actionable remediation plan by Oct 5 and schedule a 30-minute follow-up review with your engineering/product teams.
- As an additional measure, Redwood Solutions will run a 1-month monitoring review of your workload at no charge to help prevent recurrence.

Please confirm acceptance of this package in writing so our finance and legal teams can issue the formal credit memo and amendment. Once we have acceptance, we will process credits within one billing cycle and share the RCA link when ready.

Attachments/links referenced: incident-timeline-sept25-27.pdf (received), billing-offset-calc.xlsx (internal), RCA folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-incident-rca

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Account Management, Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0114

Markus — thanks for the fast response and the concrete package. We appreciate the monitoring review offer as well. Procurement will confirm acceptance formally, but I wanted to acknowledge receipt and ask for the following before sign-off: 

1) A short credit memo template showing the two-week waiver applied to usage lines, and the 10% line item (so our accounting team can invoice-match).
2) Confirmation that the $40k cap is inclusive of both credits (i.e., the total relief will never exceed $40k).
3) RCA ETA and point-of-contact for the Oct 5 remediation checkpoint.

If you can provide the credit memo and a draft amendment by end of day Friday, procurement will aim to return a signed acceptance early next week.

Thanks,
Lena Park
Head of Product Operations
Streamline AI
